items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: We had a 78 player, that was Tex Williams, “Smoke Smoke Smoke that Cigarette.”

ctx.x: Oh my God, one of my favorite solos ever. That was my first record. I think that’s really why I got into jazz, honestly. We had a 78 player, that was Tex Williams, “Smoke Smoke Smoke that Cigarette.” And maybe I was three years old. I had a little child’s like baby- like chair that was a hand-me-down from my sister. And we had a 78 player and my parents would sit me down in front of the 78 player, thank you for playing that, and they would play “Smoke Smoke Smoke that Cigarette.” And it had that swing violin solo…
